title: The Counterweight Riddle at Thunderstep Pass
story: A rockslide is rumbling down Thunderstep Pass, and the drawbridge that would carry the village goat-herders to safety hangs frozen in the air. Snollbright the Scale Toad squats on the winch, belly broad as a millstone, and croaks that the bridge only lowers for someone who knows exactly what it is carrying. Mr 6 peers into the counterweight chest and starts figuring.
question: The counterweight chest holds 10 identical sky-iron ingots plus one 14-pound chain, and the whole chest weighs 104 pounds. How many pounds does one sky-iron ingot weigh?
solution: Take the chain's weight out first: 104 − 14 = 90 pounds of ingots.
Split that among the 10 identical ingots: 90 ÷ 10 = 9.
praise: Dividing by 10 was exactly the right move — the chain's 14 pounds just had to come off the total before the sharing began.
hint: Not all 104 pounds is ingots. Remove the part you already know the weight of, then share what's left equally.
victory: 'Nine!' calls Mr 6, and the winch unlocks with a satisfied clunk. Snollbright blinks, re-weighs herself out of curiosity, and ends up helping the goat-herders across — she turns out to be an excellent, extremely heavy handrail.
imagePrompt: A boulder-sized toad monster perched on a rusted winch beside a half-raised rope drawbridge over a stormy mountain gorge, a numeral-six knight peering into a chest of glinting sky-iron ingots as dust from a distant rockslide rolls in.
